text: Tobias was easy to work with and handled feedback well throughout the project. We had a few rounds of adjustments on the browser tests for our broker quoting flow, and he took them in stride, asked the right questions, and kept moving quickly. The end result was a solid end-to-end suite with 160 tests running on every pull request, and we saw release regressions drop from 6 a quarter to 1.
